description.zh:
目标实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~)接口查看账号下的实例详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the target instance.
> You can call the [DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~) operation to query the details of instances under your account, including the instance ID.

description.zh:
目标资源组ID。
> 您可以调用[ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~)接口查看资源组详情，包括资源组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the target resource group.
> You can call the [ListResourceGroups](~~158855~~) operation to query the details of resource groups, including the resource group ID.

description.zh:
目标实例的地域ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~)接口查看账号下的实例详情，包括地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the target instance.
> You can call the [DescribeDrdsInstances](~~139284~~) operation to query the details of instances under your account, including the region ID.

title.zh: 将实例转移至新的资源组
title.en: Transfer an instance to a new resource group

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds update-resource-group-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --drds-instance-id drds00000000000 --new-resource-group-id rg-000000000000000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
